issues.key: send-track:leads.json truncated on origin/data by commit 015cf9d (research: L0093)
issues.title: leads.json truncated on origin/data by commit 015cf9d (research: L0093)
issues.detail: At 14:13:44 on 2026-11-13 commit 015cf9d (research: L0093, from a concurrent lead-scout session) rewrote data/leads.json with 7 insertions and 6608 deletions; the file now stops mid-record around line 19601 (a Stitch Product Manager lead, cut after "exp_min") and no longer parses. It is already on origin/data. The previous commit c9891c2 (research: L0092) parses fine. Likely cause: two processes (send-track and lead-scout/scout) wrote leads.json at the same moment while store.sync ran git reset --hard. Every lead command now fails with 'Expecting : delimiter'. Fix: restore leads.json from c9891c2 and re-apply the L0093 research, then add a file lock around store.transact so concurrent agents cannot interleave. send-track stopped writing to leads once this was found.
issues.remedy: Fixed 2026-11-13: leads.json restored from c9891c2 plus the surviving L0029 note; the 11 lost research results re-applied from pending-research. store.transact now holds a cross-process lock, save() uses a unique temp file, git calls time out, and a file that does not parse is never committed.

issues.key: lead-scout:leads.json corrupted on data branch by concurrent write (commit 015cf9d)
issues.title: leads.json corrupted on data branch by concurrent write (commit 015cf9d)
issues.detail: Commit 015cf9d 'research: L0093' (2026-11-13 14:13) truncated leads.json to invalid JSON (7 insertions, 6608 deletions; parse error line 19601 col 13). Cause: lead-scout ran 'outreach scout' in the background while running 'lead research' in the foreground; store.save() writes every process to the same leads.json.tmp path, so the two writes interleaved and transact() committed and pushed the mangled file. Last good commit: c9891c2. Fix: 'git -C data revert 015cf9d && git push origin HEAD:data' (my revert was blocked by the permission classifier), then re-run research for L0093-L0128 from the saved JSON in the run notes. Code fix: give save() a unique temp name (e.g. tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile in DATA_DIR) and validate JSON before commit; also a hung 'git fetch' from 13:17 (pid 62733, another session) and 'cannot lock ref' races when two CLI calls sync at once. Separately: 'lead research' auto-rejected L0090 (AiSteth) with 'score 64 is under 65' although decision was qualify.
issues.remedy: Fixed 2026-11-13: leads.json restored from c9891c2 plus the surviving L0029 note; the 11 lost research results re-applied from pending-research. store.transact now holds a cross-process lock, save() uses a unique temp file, git calls time out, and a file that does not parse is never committed.

issues.key: send-track:git fetch of data branch hangs for hours
issues.title: git fetch of data branch hangs for hours
issues.detail: On 2026-11-14 several 'git -C data fetch origin data' calls (from store.sync) hung for 2+ hours with no timeout, while github.com answered normally. One hung fetch held the store lock and blocked every write until the process was killed. store._git passes timeout=180 but child git-remote-https processes outlived it; consider GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_LIMIT/TIME env and killing the process group on timeout. Also seen once: 'git reset --hard origin/data' exit 128 while another session was syncing.
issues.remedy: Fixed in 6ebb3bd: git now runs in its own process group that is killed on timeout along with git-remote-https; a stalled connection gives up after 30 s; fetch and push fail after 90 s with a clear 'no answer from GitHub' error instead of holding the store lock. Inside a sandboxed shell with no network the commands now fail in 90 s; run them outside the sandbox.

issues.detail: Bounced today: M0128 savin@outerbounds.com (14:53 IST), M0134 vishnu@innerfit.me (15:07 IST); 7 on 20 Nov. Total 9 bounced of 153 sent = 5.9%, above the 5% limit. Cause: guess/unverified founder addresses while Reoon credits are spent (I0016). Remedy: hold guess/catch-all addresses in the founder queue until credits reset; send only verified/published ones. Bounced addresses are suppressed.
issues.remedy: Corrected cause: these are not guessed addresses. 11 of the 13 bounces are founder-list addresses imported as verified from an earlier check with unknown method and date (11 of 181 first emails, 6.1%). Every queued email has that same grade, so holding guesses would not help. Shlok to decide: pause the founder campaign until the list is re-checked, or carry on over the 5% limit.

issues.title: research-worker run marked failed 21 Nov 13:22
issues.detail: Run logged failed but summary shows 23 researched (4 qualified, 19 rejected), 16 left for a person. Work was done; failure flag cause not visible in the log. Check run output on the Mac. Writer also stopped at 13:26 because Gemini free quota (20/day/model) was used on all four models: 0 drafts today.

issues.key: supervisor:Mac sender hung since 08:50 on 22 Nov: IMAP read has no timeout
issues.title: Mac sender hung since 08:50 on 22 Nov: IMAP read has no timeout
issues.detail: PID 68095 (outreach cycle) is blocked in an SSL read on Gmail IMAP port 993 after the Mac slept. mailbox.py opens IMAP4_SSL without a timeout, and launchd will not start another run while this one lives, so the Mac sender is stopped. GitHub's cycle still sends now and then. Not restarted: awaiting Shlok.
issues.remedy: Cause: inbox reads (IMAP) had no time limit, so a dropped connection hung the sender for hours. Fix: every IMAP connection now gives up after 60 s (tested against a silent server). Live since 16:36 on 23 Nov: PR 17 merged (7923bdb) and pulled into the Mac sender's folder. The 16:45 run finished in under a minute. A real Mac sleep during a read has not been seen yet.

issues.key: supervisor:A concurrent sync can undo a send claim, so an email could go out twice
issues.title: A concurrent sync can undo a send claim, so an email could go out twice
issues.detail: Found and reproduced 22 Nov: store.sync resets without the store lock; send.claim returned True while the pushed status stayed approved. Audit of sent emails found no duplicate address and kind so far. Fix is in PR 17, not live until merged and the Mac's shared folder is pulled.
issues.remedy: Cause: store.sync reset the data folder without holding the store lock, so another process could wipe a send claim (and once, a settle). Fix: sync now takes the lock (reproduced before, gone after). Live since 16:36 on 23 Nov: PR 17 merged (7923bdb) and pulled into the Mac sender's folder. Correction: the 22 Nov audit of stored records could not rule out a past double send. Checked again: no message ID was claimed twice in 310 claims on the data branch. That is strong evidence, not proof; Gmail Sent was not checked. Seen in effect on 23 Nov: M0409's sent mark and M0389's failure were lost while a scheduled agent wrote at the same time; the inbox check repaired both (M0409 found in Sent, M0389 not sent).

issues.key: lead-scout:Scout 23 Nov: 0 qualified, LinkedIn 429 and Instahyre 403
issues.title: Scout 23 Nov: 0 qualified, LinkedIn 429 and Instahyre 403
issues.detail: LinkedIn job pages returned 429 for some leads and Instahyre returns 403, so L1960 (Snabbit Founder's Office Manager) and L1961 (Propelld) could not be verified open. 6 leads were already marked closed. Steps 2, 2b, 3b not run this budget.
issues.remedy: Cause: LinkedIn 429 rate limits and Instahyre 403 block plain HTTP readers, same root cause as I0012. L1960 and L1961 stay unverified rather than qualified, which is the correct safe behaviour. Remedy: read them via the built-in browser, or leave until the 429 window passes; no action needed today.

issues.title: 64 messages sit in failed state; supervisor check fails on them
issues.detail: 23 Nov 20:xx IST check: 64 messages are failed. 52 are TimeoutError (Gmail connect timeouts, Mac had no connection 08:05-10:05 on 23 Nov, M0347-M0399 range, already diagnosed in J0988-J0998), 9 are SMTPServerDisconnected 'connection reset by peer' and 2 are 'send interrupted, not in Sent folder' (all from 20 Nov, M0109-M0119).
